properties.description:
**AB000001 — Calgary - Crowchild Trail NW / Nose Hill Dr. NW**

**Site Address**

82 CROWFOOT CIR NW, CALGARY, AB, T3G2T3

**Site Info / Notes**

Lockbox - 6713 Lockbox installed right side of the
shelter,

beside electrical meter

Gate Lock Combo - 2808

Lock Combo - 2500

KeyBox#90 Take Crowchild West to Nosehill turn right to
first traffic light, turn left to Crowfoot Circle, Turn
left at CO-OP, property on left side of street at 21
Crowfoot Circle.

IDEN Shutdown - March 8, 2017

Safety Issue

P1 New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

P1 ADT installed. Please use TID and XID for disarm the
alarm system.

New ADT access guidelines: Pls check the safety tab

**GPS Coordinates**

**Site Address**

15101 121A AV NW, EDMONTON, AB, T5V1A3, Canada

**Site Info / Notes**

15101 121a Av NW, Edmonton, AB, T5V 1A3 From the
Yellowhead, turn south on 149 St and then turn west on
121a Ave NW. Building will be on your right.

Call Mike @ 780-993-6582 for access

Safety Issue

P1 New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**Useful Contact Info**

Call Mike @  for access — 780-993-6582

IDEN SKELETON SITE P2.1 ADT installed on Jul. 8, 2020 .
Please use TID and XID for disarm the alarm system.

Safety Issue

New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

, ,

Located in the shelter at the rear of Medical Center.

Safety Issue P1 ADT installed on Pct. 13, 2020. Please use
TID and XID for disarm the alarm system.

New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus Wireless RF Operation of their
Telus ID numbers which should be added in telus ADT
security system, otherwise the Lenel card readers will not
recognize your cards Call NOC as you normally would to get
the key code for the lockbox if you need to get in the
shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

RE NOTE: tenants on tower - Rogers CAL issued to Rogers on
Apr 25, 2018 P1 ADT installed on Pct. 13, 2020. Please use
TID and XID for disarm the alarm system.

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus Wireless RF Operation of their
Telus ID numbers which should be added in telus ADT
security system, otherwise the Lenel card readers will not
recognize your cards Call NOC as you normally would to get
the key code for the lockbox if you need to get in the
shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your

timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

Feb 22, 2022: Vendor Upgrade + N78 (S007):

Safety Issue P2.1 ADT installed on Jul. 20. Please use TID
and XID for disarm the alarm system.

New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

Ensure work does not block access to businesses in the the
lot, including 24/7 Car Wash. Must you pre-approved crane
location. LL contact is:

properties.description:
**AB000021 — First Lutheran Church**

**Site Address**

19 ASPEN RIDGE LN SW, CALGARY, AB, T3H4G7

**Site Info / Notes**

Lockbox door code - 379 , located beside

electrical meter inside fence;

Gate fence combo 9300.

Sarcee Tr to Bow Tr NW. West on Bow Tr to Strathcona Blvd.
Left at Strathcona to 14th Ave. 14th to 1st Lutheran.

Site located in Church parking lot. Equipment in compound.

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people

second tones 1 tone per second.

the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

TCI key - Gate and Door

Gate lock - 9300

Lockbox - 483

Shelter is south one (medeco key) Telus AFS Site. West of
COP, off Old Banff Coach Rd.

IDEN Shutdown March 10, 2017

CDMA decomissioned Sept 13, 2017

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

428 Moraine Road NE, Calgary

**Site Info / Notes**

Lockbox 864 Shelter GATES - 3657,

CDMA Shelter - Padlock 4860.

Main gate- 5824

KeyBox#78

428 Moraine Rd NE.

A&B Plumbing yard, Phone #: 403 284 4848 Self support
tower in SE corner of lot.

IDEN Shutdown March 10, 2017

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

P2.2 ADT installed on Jul. 9, 2020. Please use TID and XID
for disarm the alarm system.

you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**Site Info / Notes**

iDEN Medeco key, lockbox 293 (Jan 2018),

gate 9300 Following Hwy 1 into Medicine hat travelling
East, turn right at first set of lights (7th Street SW)
and travel up hill. Site is in the back parking lot.

IDEN SKELETON SITE

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**AB000106 — CN Railyards (Abbotsfield)**

**Site Address**

12520 34 St, Edmonton, AB, T5E 4B4

**Site Info / Notes**

Gate combo 2500, Push Button Lock Box

(Combo 1254)

12520 - 34 Street, Edmonton AB.

Travel on Antony Henday East Leg to Hwy 16 head West on
(Yellowhead Trail) over Beverly Bridge continue under
overpass of Victoria Trail on Yellowhead Trail turn in to
the Cell site will be shortly after on ramp on your right
had side you will see the Monopole along the CN Train
Tracks on your right had side turn in is before Monopoles.

Access Turn off to site heading West on Yellowhead only
(2nd Tower After turning along railway tracks) IDEN
SHUTDOWN (July 12/2016)

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

May 5, 2021: NOTE - Due to proximity of TELUS Tower to CN
Rail track, work on tower is subject to CN's approval and
coodrination of Flagger as required. CN has a Risk
Managment Policy and Safety Protocols that Contracotors
are to familiarize themselves with and are POSTED IN CFS
for reference. Please contact Sandra Medic and/or Tyler
Selk for any questions.

NOTE: CN INSURANCE REQUIREMENTS ARE 10 MILLION AND PROOF
OF INSURANCE WILL BE REQUIRED FOR ANY WORK.

**GPS Coordinates**

There will be two shelters located onsite. The iDEN

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

Continue to Range Rd 203, on the South side of Hwy 15 turn

RE NOTE: tenants on this tower: Access Pipeline Inc (now
named Wolf energy) Safety Issue

in case of: Critical 65090 Vandalism/Tamper Critical alarm
please call RCMP @ 7809807200 and report a theft in
progress, P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

,

New Lease Commencing May 1, 2019:

LL responsible for Weed Control, Brushing and Snow Removal
and is paid for his services. If LL does not provide these
services as prescribed, advise Telus Real Estate and Telus
may elect to resume control.

See Section 32) of Lease for details if required.

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

properties.description:
**AB000591 — Rimbey**

**Site Address**

99999 NE 35 42 2 W5, PONOKA COUNTY, AB

**Site Info / Notes**

Gate combo 9300, Door combo 8543 NE 35-42-02 W5M. Hwy 2 to
Hwy 53. Travel West 36 kms on Hwy 53 and turn left (South)
onto RR21. 750m South on RR21 to access road on West side.
Tower located in field.

IDEN Shutdown March 7, 2017

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

visable on the left side of the secondary Hwy 7.5 kms road
repaired no gates site fenced in from field.

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

, in case of: Critical 65090 Vandalism/Tamper Critical
alarm please call RCMP @ 7807274446 and report a theft in
progress,

the Back or Eastside of Stripmall

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

Site Access Door on East (backside) of Strip Mall

Evergreen 2, due to vandalism.

RE NOTE: tenants on this tower: GOA *****TELUS SMART
SECURITY SITE*******

NOC SCRIPTING:

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

1. Ensure you have your 4 digit access code ready No code?
Contact your manager. (If this is a contractor they
contact their own manager)

2. Enter code immediately after entering shelter and
ensure you re-arm when you leave (Please say this)

3. When Sign out call happens, remind them to re-arm alarm
system. (Please remind them to re-arm)

should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

after the junction, take second right over railway tracks,
tower is on LHS Safety Issue

in case of: Critical 65090 Vandalism/Tamper Critical alarm
please call RCMP @ 7809423600 and report a theft in
progress, P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

Generator Repair Call Wajax numbers below;

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

properties.description:
**AB000701 — Mayerthorpe**

**Site Address**

99999 57414 RNG RD 94, LAC STE ANNE COUNTY, AB

**Site Info / Notes**

Gate combo 2500, 3000B medeco master lock box combo 6520 .
Lock box located by generator hook up box on north side of

building NE 20-57-09 W5M. Travel West on Hwy 16, take Hwy
43 North towards Grande Prairie, turn left in Mayerthorpe
onto Hwy 22, immediately turn right to follow side road
towards Mayerthorpe airport. Take this side road for 10
kms. Site will be on the left.

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

IDEN SKELETON SITE

Safety Issue !!!!!!!!! Farmer has Electric fence . Wear
gloves when opening the Gate!!!!!!!!!!!!!, P1 site. New
ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

properties.name: AB100022
properties.description:
**AB100022 — Calgary - 215 36 Ave NE**

**Site Address**

215 36 AV NE, Calgary, AB, T2E 2L4

**Site Info / Notes**

Safety Issue P2.2 ADT installed on Oct. 7, 2020. Please
use TID and XID for disarm the alarm system.

New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus Wireless RF Operation of their
Telus ID numbers which should be added in telus ADT
security system, otherwise the Lenel card readers will not
recognize your cards Call NOC as you normally would to get
the key code for the lockbox if you need to get in the
shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**GPS Coordinates**

51.084742, -114.058091

[[Navigate in Google Maps|https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=51.084742,-114.058091]]

properties.name: AB001007
properties.description:
**AB001007 — Airways Industrial Park**

**Site Address**

2181 41 AV NE, CALGARY, AB, T2E6P2

**Site Info / Notes**

Lockbox- 7295

Tower gate 9300

GATE - MGT

Main yard Gate 1027

Door Lockbox - CAR Shelter located in the back of the
autobody yard at 2181 - 41 Avenue NE.

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**GPS Coordinates**

properties.name: AB001012
properties.description:
**AB001012 — ALYTH**

**Site Address**

2030 11 ST NE, CALGARY, AB, T2G3G3

**Site Info / Notes**

GATE - 2101. Lockbox - 0652

Shelter Door - Western Radio key 1/2 block east on 20 Ave
SE from 11st, cross tracks and turn right. Parallel tracks
to site. Watch for trains both directions.

2021: CM NEEDS TO FILL IN CP RAIL FLAGGING FORM AND SUBMIT
SCHEDULE AND PAYMENT TO CP WELL IN ADVANCE OF SCHEDULED
WORK. CONTRACTOR REQUIRES 25M INSURANCE LIABILITY.

N/A May need to walk in if snow is too high.

Safety Issue

New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus Wireless RF Operation of their
Telus ID numbers which should be added in telus ADT
security system, otherwise the Lenel card readers will not
recognize your cards Call NOC as you normally would to get
the key code for the lockbox if you need to get in the
shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

P1 ADT installed on Jul. 8, 2020. Please use TID and XID
for disarm the alarm system.

**GPS Coordinates**

RE NOTE: tenants on this tower: GOA

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

properties.description:
**AB001029 — Blackfoot**

**Site Address**

825 64 Avenue SE, Calgary

**Site Info / Notes**

Main GATE - Keybox at Bonavista CO

Keybox #50

Compound Gate - 9201

DOOR - 347

KeyBox#50

803 - 64 Ave SE.

East of Maple Leaf Self Storage.

Main Gate Padlock belongs to the City.

Lock issues, Call Irene with the City 403-268-3295

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

2204

properties.name: AB102990
properties.description:
**AB102990 — Edmonton - 858 Lewis Greens Dr NW**

**Site Address**

858 Lewis Greens Dr NW, Edmonton, AB T5T 1S9, Canada

**Site Info / Notes**

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

properties.name: AB001040
properties.description:
**AB001040 — Calmar**

**Site Address**

99999 49444 RNG RD 272, LEDUC COUNTY, AB, T0C0V0

**Site Info / Notes**

Compound gate combo: 2500

Door key lockbox combo: 2567

Door key type: Medeco 3000B(core 1086) 4 kms West of
Calmar, turn South to tower.

*****TELUS SMART SECURITY SITE*******

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

NOC SCRIPTING:

1. Ensure you have your 4 digit access code ready No code?
Contact your manager. (If this is a contractor they
contact their own manager)

2. Enter code immediately after entering shelter and
ensure you re-arm when you leave (Please say this)

3. When Sign out call happens, remind them to re-arm alarm
system. (Please remind them to re-arm)

RE COMMENT: CONTACT LL 48HRS PRIOR TO ACCESSING THE SITE

RE NOTE: tenants on this tower: GOA

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**AB001069 — Country Hills 1**

**Site Address**

9703 Centre Street North, Calgary

**Site Info / Notes**

Door lock: 1076

Gate lock: 8164 West side of South Road & Harvest Hills
Blvd NW.

Site and Monopole by Golf Course closest to west side of
Harvest Hills Blvd.

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

lock box 230. medeco master

KeyBox#126 South of Calgary on HWY 2, then 7.2 km East on
HWY 547. Site is in the field on the North side of the
Hwy.

DEC 13/ 18. new batteries were installed

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

RE NOTE:

Tenants: Foothills Amateur Radio. CAL issued in August
2018.

**AB001122 — Hunterhorn Plaza**

**Site Address**

556 64 Avenue NE, Calgary

**Site Info / Notes**

Tower Gate - 9300

Shelter Door - 4151

Lock Box - 3925

Hunterhorn Plaza. 64 Ave & 4 St NE

Site north side of tower P1 ADT installed on Jul. 10,
2020. Please use TID and XID for disarm the alarm system.

Safety Issue

New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus Wireless RF Operation of their
Telus ID numbers which should be added in telus ADT
security system, otherwise the Lenel card readers will not
recognize your cards Call NOC as you normally would to get
the key code for the lockbox if you need to get in the
shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

properties.description:
**AB001163 — Marlborough Park**

**Site Address**

5388 Memorial Dr. N.E.

**Site Info / Notes**

Gates - 9300

Lockbox - 6143

MEDECO Master

HID Card Reader 5288 Memorial Drive SE in a separate
shelter at the back, accessible from the NE corner of the
landlord's parking lot.

At night you must use the combination lock on the gate at
the north side of the landlord's parking lot, which is
accessible from the shopping centre.

ADT Alarmed Site Site is alarmed w/ siren, has video
surveillance w/ facial recognition, and has HID card
reader for access Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access
guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**GPS Coordinates**

turnoff, and take a right at the sign for Rockyford).
Travel South 8 km, tower is on the left (East side of
road).

IDEN SKELETON SITE Address of wellsite on property is:

Safety Issue P1 ADT installed on Jul. 16, 2020. Please use
TID and XID for disarm the alarm system.

New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus Wireless RF Operation of their
Telus ID numbers which should be added in telus ADT
security system, otherwise the Lenel card readers will not
recognize your cards Call NOC as you normally would to get
the key code for the lockbox if you need to get in the
shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

23301 Range Rd 233.

new supports. Also of note, Range Rd. 233 South of the
tower is under construction. Alternate path suggested.**

**Site Address**

99999 280021A HWY 616, COUNTY OF WETASKIWIN, AB

**Site Info / Notes**

Compound gate combo: 2500

Door key lockbox combo: 1456 *Lockbox location: hidden
underneath HVAC

on wall opposite shelter door*

Door key type: Medeco 3000b(core 1452) South of Calmar on
Hwy 795 about 24km west on 616 about 10km, north side in
farmers field The site has got Telus Security System
Installed. Please follow the disarm/arm process while
doing normal site access (NOC) as well

Safety Issue New Telus Security System access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

the Gondola mechanical room.

configuration per Eric Smith is as follows.

Calgary to Canmore on Fibre, to a RICI unit output as T1s,
then to a Optera 3500 unit converted to fibre, to Banff
CO, Optera 3500 system converts to 16 T1s on PCM to
Sunshine Village Main Customer Service area (lower level),

escort you. Once through, first door on left is cable
entry room , where SIJs, SIJ's DSX and RICI's DSX are
located. SIJ outputs to RICI inputs via DSX x-connects.
The Server room is the third door on the left also locked
and will have to be opened for you, Here the RICI converts
16 T1's to Ethernet, Ethernet to the RAD unit, and Fibre
out (2 single modes) to the Clock Tower room where the
Node B is located.

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

If the repair, replacement, modification, expansion or
relocation is anticipated to take more than one day then
TELUS must notify the Landlord prior to entry Garry &
Adele Skrepnek - 780-625-5005 TELUS is to spray weeds on
the leased premises on an annual basis or as directed by

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

properties.description:
**AB001320 — Peigan**

**Site Address**

4420 Harvetta Road

**Site Info / Notes**

Gate lock 3030,

Shelter compound Gate lock - 3287

Lockbox - 402

KeyBox#60 You must take Peigan Tr Westbound to the
Deerfoot Tr on-ramp. There is an access road that leads
off the ramp on the West side of the ramp (you drive past
the tower). Watch for it!!! If you miss it you will be
Southbound on Deerfoot.

*We own this property, not the City* Snowplowing may block
access to site.

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

IDEN shutdown Jan. 27, 2017

*We own this property, not the City* Snowplowing may block
access to site.

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

IDEN shutdown Jan. 27, 2017

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from

safety sake, a review of weights of such items as ballast,
that holds the antenna frames down, steel components, etc.
to assure we do not over load elevator capacities.

f) Further because the additional traffic in the elevators
will effect our tenants use, we need to give notice to the
tenants, and would require a specific pre presented
schedule for the work, and suggested elevator booking
times, to pre schedule as required.

Obviously these bookings should not be at the end or the
beginning of the month, when move ins are most prominent.

**AB001396 — Taradale North**

**Site Address**

99999 SE 25 25 29 W4, ROCKY VIEW COUNTY, AB

**Site Info / Notes**

Lockbox - 0518

Gate - 4591

KeyBox#17 Travel 1km North on 84 St NE from Country Hlls
Blvd. Turn West into the field and follow the road 200m
North to the site.

Latest Battery Theft occurred March 17, 2019 Battery theft
occurred last July 20, 2018. No battery backup onsite. If
the site goes out of service (NE Disconnect of LTE and
UMTS) please have RF OPS tech deploy genset.

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

MW hop: AB1396- AB2855 4+0

**AB001434 — Kearl Lake**

**Site Address**

99999 NE 21 95 7 W4, REGIONAL MUNICIPALITY OF WOOD
BUFFALO, AB

**Site Info / Notes**

211 lockbox code

2500 Gate At Fort McMurray, travel north on Highway 63 for
63.1km to the Albian Sands/Suncor, go to Firebag
(approx.50km), site on south side of road

IDEN SKELETON SITE

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

West on 33rd to Richmond Rd SW. East on Richmond as far as
you can drive. Site is beside Crowchild Tr across from old

IDEN shutdown Feb. 03, 2017

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

11444 ROCKY RIDGE RD NW, CALGARY, AB, T5B3G5

**Site Info / Notes**

3491 gate lock combo.

Medeco key in lockbox (combo is 205)

tower access padlock: 9300

KeyBox#23 254077 Rocky Ridge Road N.W. Calgary Alberta.
From Crowchild trail. head 2.7 km north. Turn left into
Butterfield acres, proceed through steel gate towards
shelter and monopole. CLOSE all gets as there are animals
at large.

During winter, path to the site need to be snowplowed to
haul DC generators.

NO AC Generator Transfer switch

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

NO louvres or DC cooling

RE NOTE: Tenanats on tower: Rogers CAL issued to Rogers on
April 16, 2018.

second tones 1 tone per second.

the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.
