This site is a Monopole

Safety Issue

New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus Wireless RF Operation of their
Telus ID numbers which should be added in telus ADT
security system, otherwise the Lenel card readers will not
recognize your cards Call NOC as you normally would to get
the key code for the lockbox if you need to get in the
shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

P2.1 ADT installed on Jul. 16, 2020. Please use TID and
XID for disarm the alarm system.

start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

first left, follow the road until you see train tracks
crossing, Tower and Shelter on the right side.

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

alarm please call RCMP @ 7809926100 and report a theft in
progress,

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

lockbox is installed on Friday Nov 15, 2019 —

From Calgary Office: Highway #2 north to Hwy #12 (Lacomber
exit). East on Hwy #12 past Lacombe to Clive town road
(Range Rd. 245A). Site is located 1km east of Clive town
road. Site accessible via town road to 47 Ave east to
Range Road 245, north on Range Road 245 to dead end. Gate
on west side into farmers field. Site in field.

Colocate- CLIVE - GOA (AFRRCS)

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**UofA Roof Access Orientation card is required for

Safety Divsion 'fosafety@ualberta.ca' to request
attendance. Orientations are held every Thursday at 8am.

Campus Control Center 780-492-4855 to request a UofA F&O

rooftop(can be signed out for up to 10 days at a time).

west side of building. In order to sign out Rooftop Keys
you will first need to fill out a 'Roof Access - Key
Request Approval' form at the RE Philips Building from
Lisa Parenteau.

(780-492-4027) in Room275(call Lisa ahead for directions
to Rm275). Use Darin Bridges<bridges1@ualberta.ca> for
your UofA contact on form. You will need your UofA Rooftop
Orientation card before you can fill out the 'Roof Access'
form(see paragraph above). The AB1712 rooftop is R-02 of
the General Services Building.

From 116 St turn right onto 89 Ave, follow road around to
the north side of Stadium Car Park to find the General
Services building loading dock parking(southeast side of
GSB building). Lockbox contains FOB to enter building,
rooftop key must now be signed out from RE Philips
Building 'Repair Shop' (see paragraphs above for signout
procedure). Use key FOB to access southeast entrance door,
enter hallway to the right and follow signs to elevators.
Take elevator to 8th(top) floor, enter stairwell
immediately in front of elevator, take two flights up and
use rooftop key to gain access to the roof.

Jan 25/23 (AJ) - Please contact Darin Bridges for site
walk to discuss logistics and schedle prior to all
installations. Harpinder and Umair have all necessary
requirements as an approved vendor is required by the
Landlord.

of roof. Warning sign at top of stairwell indicates
engineered anchor points not certified so watch where you
tie yourself off to.

**Site Address**

**Site Info / Notes**

gate 9300 Lockbox is at the back under the HVAC unit -

code 610

KeyBox#59 From Calgary at the intersection of Macleod
Trail SE and Highway 22X drive west on Highway 22X for
approximately 7.7 km. At 53rd Street SW turn (right) north
and drive approximately 1.2km. The approach is located on
the (left) west side of the road.

Safety Issue P1 site. New Secruity access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**AB001758 — Avenida Village**

**Site Address**

12445 LAKE FRASER DR SE, CALGARY, AB, T2J7A4

**Site Info / Notes**

Lockbox - 2803

KeyBox#133 Take Canyon Meadows Dr to Lake Fraser Drive S E
and head North to Avenida Mall.

Go to the tower North of Lake Fraser Gate. Address is
12445 Lake Fraser Drive SE Site is a monopole just at the
entrance to the mall.

January 20, 2022 (F007) Vendor Upgrade + N78: MUST CONTACT
LL IN ADVANCE TO COORDINATE ACCESS AND WORK SCHEDULE:

"Monday or Tuesday would be the best days to work on the
cell tower do to the location of the tower being right in
front of the Fresh Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access
guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

Market's loading dock. The Market is closed these days,
and this would be the least amount of disruption to the
tenant's deliveries, also will be less busy for you to
setup a crane." PLEASE GIVE 1 WEEKS NOTICE to both of the
following individuals via EMAIL:

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**Site Address**

11150 135 ST NW, Edmonton, AB, T5M3X8

**Site Info / Notes**

Lockbox 7652 on door Lockbox for shelter inside Bell
Mobility Generator box on north side of shelter (Code

652).

Medeco 3000B Core 1429 Shelter behind Westmount Mall (West
side)

********June 25, 2021 *********** Please coordinate all
access and schedules for vendor upgrades prior to
commencing installation with;

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

14-5-2-3

GATE 9300 14 have to hit at the same time then 5 2 3

2050 10 Ave SW Head South on 14st SW, take a right (or
West) on 11ave SW. Cannot turn from 14st SW to 10 ave SW.
Any St. North to 10 Ave, Head West on 10 ave passed Bow
Trail overpass, monopole on North side of Ave in business
parking lot.

Door is on the rear of the shelter.

Site ownership transferred from Bell to TELUS June
30,2016. DOOR CODE:1&4 together then 5-2-3 Safety Issue P1
site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

P2.2 ADT installed on Jul. 14, 2020. Please use TID and
XID for disarm the alarm system.

**Site Address**

99999 SW 16 25 2 W5, CALGARY, AB, Canada

**Site Info / Notes**

Compound is Rogers - Padlocks (Both Gates)

1400 Lockbox on back of shelter (NE corner) - 3289 Whether
Eastbound or Westbound on Stony Trail, take the exit to
Tuscany Blvd NW. Head North on Tuscany Blvd and get in the
right lane. Then as you get into the left turn that heads
West, There is an access road to the site with a gate
across it. Pull off to the right and enter the access road
that heads towards the Monopole. The Gate is not locked,
so open and close it behind you. You have to cross a
cycle/pedistrian path to get to the shelter, so if it is
summer, watch out for foot or bicycle traffic. Also there
is a big square sign on the gate that acts as a sail, so
if it is windy you may have trouble getting thru without
the gate closing on you.

Site belongs to Rogers so both Compound gates have their
combo padlocks ( 1400 ) on them.

**Site Address**

wood gate combo is 9300/no padlock

Compound Gate - 9300

Tower access: 9300 East on 22x from Deerfoot to 52nd
Street. Right (South) on 52nd Street to Mahogany Gate SE.
Left (East) on Mahogany Gate to Mahagony Blvd. Left
(North) on Mahogany BLVD to Mahogany Hts. Left (North) on
Mahogany Hts to 200 Mahogany Hts. Turn Right and Gate
access is located between 202 and 206 Mahogany Hts.

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**AB002037 — Calgary - 24 Street SW/Woodpark Boulevard SW (Woodbine Park)**

**Site Address**

96 WOODFIELD CR SW, CALGARY, AB, T2W3W4, Canada

**Site Info / Notes**

Gate combo 9300

Lockbox code : 652 Calgary - 24 Street SW/Woodpark
Boulevard SW (Woodbine Park)

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**Site Address**

**Site Info / Notes**

Main Gate Lock: 8830

Gate Combo: 9300

In Marborough Ford parking lot

Crane Access Only

Safety Issue

New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus Wireless RF Operation of their
Telus ID numbers which should be added in telus ADT
security system, otherwise the Lenel card readers will not
recognize your cards Call NOC as you normally would to get
the key code for the lockbox if you need to get in the
shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

48h notice required to Marlborough Ford when using crane
as vehicles may need to be moved P2.1 ADT installed on
Jul. 8, 2020. Please use TID and XID for disarm the alarm
system.

Ford Dealership has closed down. Lock has been placed on
the main gate for Telus to access 24/7.

will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

combo 2500

Anticlimb 2400 Drive wesy of Edmonton on Hwy #16 West to
Secondary #779. Travel north to Hwy #37 and site is 2Km
north of this instersection on your left hand side.

RE NOTE:

1. Tenant on the tower: EXPORNET

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

2. FAL dated November 28, 2017 issued to Xplornet
*****TELUS SMART SECURITY SITE*******

NOC SCRIPTING:

1. Ensure you have your 4 digit access code ready No code?
Contact your manager. (If this is a contractor they
contact their own manager)

2. Enter code immediately after entering shelter and
ensure you re-arm when you leave (Please say this)

3. When Sign out call happens, remind them to re-arm alarm
system. (Please remind them to re-arm)

Kelly Collins on 05-Apr-2024

1. TELUS and its consultants thoroughly understand the
characteristics of the roof located at the Premises. TELUS
agrees to a process of clear communication and
understanding between all parties involved which shall be
maintained throughout the Installation project. TELUS
engineering consultant confirms that the Installation of
the work set out on Schedule C1 will not affect the
structural integrity of the Premises building components
or members. The Installation will meet all of the
requirements of CSA Standard S37-18 as well as all
applicable By-laws.

2. Implementation:

a. A detailed work schedule, planning and coordination
shall be conducted for all project stages, including pre,
during, and post-work activities of the New Installation.
TELUS shall deliver a work schedule to the Lessor
detailing the dates of the scope of work of the New
Installation commencement and completion. The Lessor will
assign a single point of contact (the “Lessor’s SPOC”) to
collaborate with TELUS throughout the Installation
including identifying the approved location and storage of
materials and equipment, use of tools, and overall
responsibility for maintaining the roof's integrity
throughout the Installation activities. TELUS will ensure
that proactive measures are taken to prevent damage or
issues during the Installation project.

b. TELUS agrees to work collaboratively with the Lessor’s
SPOC to minimize disruption to the landlord's use of the
roof, hotel lobby and all areas throughout the Premises,
to adhere to the rules (the “Access Conditions”) set by
the Lessor attached hereto as Schedule “E1” which outlines
TELUS access, egress, parking, a check point upon arrival
with the Lessor’s single point of contact.

Schedule “E1”

1. Access: The Lessor shall provide to TELUS and its
authorized representatives and agents such additional
rights of access on, over, under and through the premises
as required in order to maintain and repair operate the
Equipment and the Shelter, including but not limited to
the right to connect the Equipment to local utilities, to
install underground or overhead telephone or power lines
in any combination, and to install conduits for fibre or
telephone cabling. Provided however, that any new
construction or replacement shall be subject to the
Lessor's consent, not to be unreasonably withheld.

Notwithstanding recital (iv) on page 1 of the Lease, the
parties agree to the following additional protocols
relating to access to the rooftop portion of the Site and
to the ground space shelter:

a. emergency and non-emergency access to the ground space
shelter shall be permitted 24/7 all following quiet work
protocols respecting the Lessor’s hotel guests and parking
on the municipal road unless the Lessor permits hotel
parking lot parking case by case. Further rules related to
access are set out on Schedule “E”.

b. for emergency purposes access to rooftop portion of the
Site necessitating repair to restore network and cellular
coverage for E-911, TELUS must check in with Lessor’s
front desk personnel first before accessing the rooftop
Site; and c. non-emergency maintenance work to the rooftop
portion of the Site, TELUS must contact the Lessor’s
maintenance manager set out in section 2 of this Amendment
at least 1 day in advance of attendance.

d. parking by Lessee shall be limited to the area(s)
identified in the attached map Schedule B2 save that TELUS
and its personnel or contractors may park adjacent to the
ground shelter compound by parking on municipal property
for work to be conducted within the shelter
---------------

Safety Issue P1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will

card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**AB002435 — Rocky View County - Symons Valley Road/Highway 574 (Madden)**

**Site Address**

99999 30193C TWP RD 290, ROCKY VIEW COUNTY, AB,
T0M1L0

**Site Info / Notes**

Gate: 5383

Lockbox: 9805

KeyBox#16 Drive along Symons Valley Road (Highway 772
North). Turn left on TR 290. Pass the bridge then turn
left on Walsh Farm. Site is on the right side.

Transport of this site is via Ericsson MW. Repeater site
at AB0575 and the donor is at AB1070.

*****TELUS SMART SECURITY SITE*******

Safety Issue Lockbox moved to the back of the shelter at
the hydro meter, P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

,

NOC SCRIPTING:

1. Ensure you have your 4 digit access code ready No code?
Contact your manager. (If this is a contractor they
contact their own manager)

2. Enter code immediately after entering shelter and
ensure you re-arm when you leave (Please say this)

3. When Sign out call happens, remind them to re-arm alarm
system. (Please remind them to re-arm)

**AB002698 — Lac Ste. Anne County - Highway 20/Larry's Road (Soldan Lake)**

**Site Address**

99999 SW 30 53 1 W5, LAC STE. ANNE COUNTY, AB

**Site Info / Notes**

3000B

gate combo 1800

compound combo 1800

lockbox code 652 take hwy 16 east to range road 20 turn
north until just after Larry's road tower on the east side
of the road.

Electric fence is being installed around the building and
anchors as a temp measure until the fencing is done.
Cattle at large.

Safety Issue P 2.2 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**GPS Coordinates**

**AB002740 — Edmonton - 34 St/ 159 Ave (Evergreen 2)**

**Site Address**

15920 34 ST NW, EDMONTON, AB, T5B4K3

**Site Info / Notes**

Chain Link Gate Combo Lock 2500 Push Button Lock Box 302
on Shelter

Site Address 15818 - 34 STREET NW Take Manning Dr north
from 137 Avenue or 153 Avenue to Manning Town Center
(153Ave 34Street) turn east at 153 Avenue lights and drive
.5km to 34 Street turn left and follow 34 street for
approx 1km, Free Standing Tower will be on your left hand
side of road.

Safety Issue P2.1 ADT installed on Jul. 16, 2020. Please
use TID and XID for disarm the alarm system.

New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus Wireless RF Operation of their
Telus ID numbers which should be added in telus ADT
security system, otherwise the Lenel card readers will not
recognize your cards Call NOC as you normally would to get
the key code for the lockbox if you need to get in the
shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

P2.1 ADT installed on Jul. 14, 2020. Please use TID and
XID for disarm the alarm system.

2500 Combo Lock Fence around Shelter,

Code 7755 Travelling East or West on Yellowhead Trail to
127 Street turn north continue to 126 Avenue and turn
right heading East on 126th Ave continue down to 125
Street should see Monopole on northside of 126th Ave
Address 12526 126 Ave NW, Edmonton, AB, T5L 0X5

ADT Security System Installed

Safety Issue P2.1 ADT installed on Jul. 16, 2020. Please
use TID and XID for disarm the alarm system.

New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus Wireless RF Operation of their
Telus ID numbers which should be added in telus ADT
security system, otherwise the Lenel card readers will not
recognize your cards Call NOC as you normally would to get
the key code for the lockbox if you need to get in the
shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

P2.1 ADT installed on Jul. 16, 2020. Please use TID and
XID for disarm the alarm system.

Safety Issue P 2.1 site. New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

**AB002948 — Calgary – McKnight Boulevard NE/Falconridge Boulevard NE (Castleridge replacement)**

**Site Address**

33 Castleridge Blvd NE, Calgary, AB

**Site Info / Notes**

Gate - 9300

Lockbox - 652 From the intersection of 52 St
NE/Castleridge Blvd NE, go West on Castleridge Blvd NE
toward the Safeway and enter the parking lot on the North
side. Go West (right) around the North side of the
building and then turn South (left) and continue along the
West side of the building to the SW corner where you'll
find the shelter/tower.

Safety Issue

New ADT access guidelines:

• Accessing the Alarmed site.

GC needs to advise Telus of their Telus ID numbers which
should be added in telus ADT security system, Call NOC as
you normally would to get the key code for the lockbox if
you need to get in the shelter.

Lenel card readers are installed on the shelters, you will
need to swipe XID card which will disarm the burglar alarm
(BA) and the camera analytics. If you forget to swipe your
card and enter the shelter, there is a 30 second entry
timer that you will hear from the BA. After that, ADT will
be calling our monitoring center to report it, our people
will look at the cameras and make a decision.

If you forget to swipe in and just enter the shelter, you
have 30 seconds to go and swipe, you will hear the 30
second tones 1 tone per second.

• Disarming and Re-arming the site.

When you swipe the card reader, you will hear 3 tones from
the speaker for system disarm.

When you swipe again and the system is already disarmed,
you will hear constant tones for 30 seconds indicating
that it's arming.

After the 2-hour window the system will automatically
start arming with the constant tones for 30 seconds. You
can then go swipe and hear the 3 tones again for disarming
with the system timer reset for another 2 hours.

Employee ID Smart card to access the shelter. We do not
have abloy key to open the shelter. You need to push very
hard to

open the door.

****Safety issue during icy/snow condition going to the
site: ***** Road to the site is icy. Be careful when
driving on the uphill (especially at night) going to the
site compound as there is no side road block. Road is
about 3 meters wide.

Direction to the site. Take Highway 1 West, Take exit 131
(an exit after passing Bear Hill Road). Turn right to
Morley. Pass the Star Ranch Road. Turn left on entrance to
Chiniki Community College then immediately turn right to
the gravel road uphill. Site is uphill with mini tower.
Site near on the road is Telus Morley CO.

Micro cell decommissioned when AB2438 went in service.

Telus wireline CLLI: MRLYAB02RS4

Tower does not meet CSA standard

Tower cannot be climbed

Bucket truck access only

No Climb sign needed
